data.long_meaning: Onkarveer is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Onkar', which represents the sound of the supreme God in Hinduism. It is believed that chanting the syllable 'Onkar' connects one to the divine and offers spiritual growth and protection. The name Onkarveer carries the meaning “Name of God Onkar” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi.
